desc:
👻 Welcome to Dig & Steal a Ghost!

⛏️ Dig graves, steal ghosts, build the richest graveyard!
📖 Collect 200+ ghosts across 10 spooky biomes
🌈 16 mutations: Gold, Rainbow, Blood Moon and more
⭐ Star up your ghosts to 5 gold stars for huge money
🤝 Trade and gift ghosts with friends
📦 Open crates for Secret ghosts
🔁 Rebirth for crates, auras, bats and titles

How to Play:
⛏️ Dig up graves to find ghosts
🏃 Steal your ghost and outrun the Guardian
💰 Place ghosts in your graveyard to earn money
🪓 Upgrade your shovel to dig faster
💨 Train Speed to reach deeper biomes
🦇 Bat players to make them drop their ghost
💤 Your ghosts earn while you are offline
🎁 Playtime rewards and a daily free gift

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!

🎁 CODES:
GHOSTDIGGERS → +10M Speed ⚡
DIGDEEP → FREE Nightmare Crate 📦

Music: Colossal Boss Battle Theme by Matthew Pablo (CC BY 3.0); The Path of the Goblin King by Kevin MacLeod (CC BY 4.0).
Credits: Purse by @WinnersTakesAll, TopbarPlus by ForeverHD.
